item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)

expect.asks_about: Which of the two attached pictures should be upscaled?

item.title: Resolve the Upscale Target
item.tests: Asks which attachment the user means, then upscales only the selected picture without guessing or processing both.

answer_sheet.Framing: Keep the whole lake picture and its original proportions.

must_haves: The final deliverable is an upscaled version of lake-small.jpg, following clarification.
The lake, mountains, trees, clouds, and their arrangement remain faithful to the selected source.
The delivered image has larger pixel dimensions than lake-small.jpg, not merely a renamed copy.
The full original framing and aspect ratio are preserved.
Only one edited image is delivered; the dog photo is not included or blended into it.

dialog.agent:
You attached two images, so which one should I upscale?

1. **blurry-dog.jpg** (the golden retriever on the grass)
2. **lake-small.jpg** (the mountain lake at sunset)
3. **Both**, as two separate upscales

Your free plan can only upscale 2x, and each upscale uses credits. For the dog photo, keep in mind that upscaling makes the image bigger but won't fully fix the heavy blur. "Balanced" mode, the default, sharpens it best but costs twice as much as "preserve" mode. The lake photo is already fairly clear, so "preserve" should work well for it. Tell me which one you want and I'll start.
dialog.why: It asks the user to choose which image (or both) to upscale and waits for that answer before starting.
dialog.user: The lake one, lake-small.jpg. Yes, go ahead.

turns.agent:
I couldn't upscale lake-small.jpg because your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits. The upscale didn't run, so nothing was made and no download link exists.

I tried the cheapest setting there is, 2x in "preserve" mode, so a different setting won't help. I can't see your exact balance from here, but upscaling costs at least 25 credits per image.

To go ahead, you can:
- **Wait for your free credits to refill.** You can see your balance and when it resets in your Magic Hour account settings.
- **Buy a credit pack or upgrade your plan** in Magic Hour.

Once you have more credits, tell me and I'll run the 2x upscale on the lake photo again.
